rules.statement: Existing conflicting container packages are reported, not removed automatically.
rules.title: Conflicting container packages are not removed automatically
rules.why: Avoids destructive host changes during Docker setup.

rules.statement: The Docker daemon is exposed only through its local Unix socket.
rules.title: Docker daemon stays on the local Unix socket
rules.why: Avoids exposing the Docker control plane over a network interface.

rules.statement: Only the interactive Linux user joins the powerful `docker` group.
rules.title: Only the interactive user joins the docker group
rules.why: Keeps Docker-equivalent host authority limited to the intended interactive account.
